newsitem.title: TURKEY: IMF urges Turkey for fiscal adjustment -- bankers.
newsitem.headline: IMF urges Turkey for fiscal adjustment -- bankers.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has urged Turkey to implement a fiscal adjustment programme to correct imbalances in the troubled economy, banking sources say.

In a report written after a consultation visit by an IMF team to Ankara in April, the Fund suggested the programme should be supported through structural measures, aimed at speeding up privatisation, curbing losses of state pension institutions, rationalisation of farm subsidy policies and reforming the tax system, they said.
"The report is expected to come before the IMF executive board at a meeting on Wednesday," said a banker who declined to be named.
The report also points at fragility of the banking system and asks for some measures under the fiscal adjustment programme, sources say.
